title: Zimbra security advisory (AV26-816)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-816 Date: August 14, 2026 As of August 13, 2026, Zimbra is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: Collaboration - Prior to 10.1.20 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Zimbra Security Advisories - Zimbra: Tech Center Zimbra Responsible Disclosure Policy - Zimbra: Tech Center Zimbra: Blog - All Things Zimbra Article Link: Zimbra security advisory (AV26-816) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
exclude_reason: duplicates existing story: CCCS AV26-816 re-advisory of the Zimbra Collaboration 10.1.20 patch (July release) already covered by zimbra-collaboration-suite-10-1-20-critical-command-injection-xs; no new CVEs, versions, or exploitation claims in the event content
